description: Held-out phrasings for recognising a practitioner's situation from their own words. None of these appear in agents/intent_catalogue.py. Levels: 'expert' uses statutory terms, 'plain' is ordinary but specific, 'minimal' is the least a user might type. The 'mentor' items are the questions put to the system at the mentor review on 2026-09-17. Items were drafted with an AI model; teammates should add phrasings of their own, written without looking at the catalogue, so the score is not measured only on the model's style.
